subject: Progress of Parallel Stan in RStudio

messages.author: a387d7985c232d82
messages.subject: Progress of Parallel Stan in RStudio
parts:
Hello all,

I would like to run Stan in parallel with the following code, which utilizes the mclappy function from the parallel package:
  stan.par <- mclapply(1:n.chain, mc.cores=n.chain, FUN=function(chain) {
      stan(model_code=stan.code, data=stan.data, iter=n.iter, chains=1,
             warmup=n.warm, thin=n.thin, verbose=FALSE, chain_id=chain,
             refresh=max(floor(n.iter/100), 1), pars=pars.to.save, seed=chain
             )})

This has worked well except when I try to run it on RStudio, which appears to suppress the progress bar updates from the respective chains. This is unfortunately because I am running some very long jobs and would like some sense of when they will finish. Changing to verbose=TRUE doesn't help things. I imagine that this problem is not unique to Stan, so has anyone encountered it before? If so, did you find a solution? Thanks for the help!

Devin

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: Progress of Parallel Stan in RStudio
parts:
RStudio does not propagate the output of forked processes to the RStudio console. If you are doing this, it is best to start R via a shell (such as the Terminal app in the Utilities subfolder of Applications on a Mac)

Ben
